placements.frame: What retro format is the team running now, what did it replace, and what prompted or marked the change?
placements.why: No existing leaf covers team process; both analytics-platform leaves are about infrastructure choices. The retro-format change is a settled, team-process decision that future retro and process envelopes will keep feeding, so it is a theme rather than a one-off fact. It is minted standalone.
